escalation_note: Six tight crops, all A3 indexing proofs: p2 row 1 rendered 480.84 and row 3 rendered 2,000.00 via make_snippet --value at 900 dpi. TOOL LIMITATION FOUND ON p3: that page is 612x792 pts with /Rotate 270, so poppler renders it LANDSCAPE while make_snippet.py sizes its crop from the UNROTATED pdfinfo page size - a pct box in the rendered frame resolves to the wrong place (my first two p3 proofs landed on the City/Purpose columns of row 4 instead of the Amount column of rows 1 and 4). The stored geometry follows the contract (pct of the page AS POPPLER RENDERS IT, rotation included), and the proof was therefore taken with a DIRECT pdftoppm crop in the rendered frame at 900 dpi (rendered page 9900x7650 px): -x 7335 -y 2130 -W 850 -H 196 rendered '$469.11' (row 1) and -x 7335 -y 2718 rendered '$2,000.00' (row 4), both the recorded amounts. scripts/campaign_finance/ is frozen for this wave so nothing was changed - reporting instead.
